therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonism / basal insulin supplementation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: glycemic control via incretin-mediated insulin secretion and basal glucose lowering
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on liraglutide and metformin
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change from randomisation in HbA1c at Week 26

results.effect_size: Estimated treatment difference (insulin detemir + lira vs lira alone): -0.52 percentage points (95% CI: -0.68 to -0.36)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Fasting plasma glucose reduced by -2.12 mmol/L in insulin detemir + lira arm vs -0.39 mmol/L in lira alone arm at Week 26
biomarker_changes: HbA1c change at Week 26: -0.51 pp (insulin detemir + lira) vs +0.02 pp (lira alone)
Fasting plasma glucose change at Week 26: -2.12 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.39 mmol/L (lira alone)
Fasting pro-insulin change at Week 26: -9.78 pmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -1.12 pmol/L (lira alone)
Fasting C-peptide change at Week 26: -0.32 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.08 mmol/L (lira alone)
Body weight change at Week 26: -0.16 kg (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.95 kg (lira alone)
Triglycerides change at Week 26: -0.33 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.24 mmol/L (lira alone)
Free fatty acids change at Week 26: -0.11 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.03 mmol/L (lira alone)
subgroup_findings: Prandial glucose increment at breakfast Week 26: -2.09 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.97 mmol/L (lira alone)
Prandial glucose increment at lunch Week 26: -1.43 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.83 mmol/L (lira alone)
Prandial glucose increment at dinner Week 26: -1.18 mmol/L (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.48 mmol/L (lira alone)
Minor hypoglycaemic episodes Weeks 0-26: 22 (insulin detemir + lira) vs 2 (lira alone)
Minor hypoglycaemic episodes Weeks 0-52: 33 (insulin detemir + lira) vs 4 (lira alone)
safety_signals: No major hypoglycaemic episodes in either randomised arm through Week 26 or Week 52
Minor hypoglycaemic episodes more frequent in insulin detemir + lira arm (22 vs 2 at Week 26; 33 vs 4 at Week 52)
Symptoms-only hypoglycaemia: 19 (insulin detemir + lira) vs 9 (lira alone) at Week 26
Total adverse events: 845 (insulin detemir + lira) vs 716 (lira alone) over run-in to Week 52
Serious adverse events in insulin detemir + lira arm included ankle fracture, head injury, joint injury

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Adding basal insulin detemir to liraglutide + metformin further lowers fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c beyond what liraglutide alone achieves, amplifying overall glycemic control biology
modulation_entries.citation: Estimated Treatment Difference, LSMean = -0.52 (95% CI: -0.68–-0.36) for insulin detemir + lira vs lira alone at Week 26

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Liraglutide's postprandial glucose lowering and weight-neutral/weight-reducing effect complements basal insulin detemir, mitigating weight gain typically associated with insulin therapy
modulation_entries.citation: Body weight change at Week 26: -0.16 kg (insulin detemir + lira) vs -0.95 kg (lira alone); insulin detemir addition did not cause meaningful weight gain in the context of liraglutide co-administration
